system.description: While Manic, you can spend your Bonus Action to violently expel excess Nature Energy. All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure they take 2d8 force damage and are knocked Prone. This increases to 4d8 at 7th level and 6d8 at 15th level. Regardless of a success or failure, roll 1d4, reducing your Nature Energy by the result.
